title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Lantern Hill Cardiology under your Medicare Advantage plan for services provided on September 3, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
This claim was not filed within the time limit set by your plan and cannot be paid. Reason code: CO-29.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $128.42 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $128.42.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Tamsin Health Partners, Appeals Unit, PO Box 18381, Erie, PA 16501. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-6511.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
